shared.aggregation: one scene prediction = max of all eligible original-rule slice risks
shared.primary_processability: label resolved, target applicable, context accepted, nonempty complete original-rule slice inventory, every slice successful for every included method and seed; common intersection frozen before scores
shared.partial_policy: diagnostic only: any observed slice >= 0.5 proves positive lower bound; otherwise unknown whenever inventory incomplete or any slice missing; never include partial scenes in primary scores
shared.slice_selection: unchanged original frontend rule, identical for both labels; never use official flaw lines
shared.model_parser: legacy Joern plus original functions only; tree-sitter is structure/ownership/sanitization only
shared.source_policy: one sanitized source per effective member; no inline, join, graph completion or parser substitution
shared.clone_limit: template naming groups and exact raw/sanitized hashes only; near-clone and unknown clone overlap unmeasured
shared.diagnostic_policy: external source contents never logged; any inspected real source marks its entire template family as development diagnostic

juliet.label_rule: official Juliet good/bad entry naming plus parsed function definition and structural entry ownership; unknown roots retain null label
juliet.group_rule: filename template prefix before terminal two-digit flow; family retains flow, removes filepart/class-role suffix; no semantic clone inference
juliet.good_wrapper_rule: split only nonempty body consisting exclusively of direct zero-argument calls to unique defined goodB2G/goodG2B-style void(void) branches; wrapper not another scene
juliet.arithmetic_applicability: 190/191 starts diagnostic_pending_memory_check; original frontend keys/operation kinds may identify memory-related diagnostics without official flaw lines; only established pure arithmetic is task_not_applicable

mit.label_rule: variant mapping must agree with official SARIF state and result kind; disagreement is label_unresolved
mit.entry_rule: one official base-case/variant scene, main entry; helpers belong to that scene, never independent labeled samples

supplement.replacement_reason: official candidate v2 replaces deprecated v1 (original properties.id=834); original archive retained
